body:
FIX ROUND 1 (OPENING) (M-COACHPUSH-123, agent 123) — growth-project-mobile#393 @ 59ec57770771b4f98f61e5ffc3180cef37b129c4

Job F8. Two items, one PR.

**(a) C-S-PUSH-3: coach push permission ask.** Before this PR, a fresh coach install never saw the OS notification ask, because the opt-in card was only on client Home. Coaches therefore missed client messages and new-client alerts.
- `src/screens/coach/ClientsListScreen.tsx` is the coach landing tab (CoachNavigator initial tab ClientsStack > ClientsList; it mounts only after the coach wizard). It now mounts `<PushPermissionCard audience="coach" />` under the header.
- `src/components/home/PushPermissionCard.tsx` has a new optional `audience` prop. The client copy is unchanged. The coach copy is "Turn on notifications so you see client messages and new client alerts."
- No new permission logic. The card uses the same per-user dismiss key (shows once per account) and appears only while not granted and the OS can still ask. The OS prompt comes only from "Turn on", and the token goes through the existing `registerForPushNotifications({ requestPermission: true })` + `usersApi.updatePushToken` path.

**(b) C-F6-1: Community "Send your coach a message".**
- On `CommunityTodayScreen`, the no-cohort button did nothing while community DMs are off. It now opens Home > Messages (the 1:1 coach thread), the same target as the m#389 no-workspace state. With DMs on it still opens the community DM inbox.
- A client with no coach sees no message button on Today or on the `CommunitySpaceScreen` no-workspace state. `CommunityEmptyState` now treats its action as optional and renders the CTA only when it gets both a label and a handler.

**Tests (fail on main first)**
- `communityMessageCoach.test.tsx` (5): on main 3 fail and 2 regression guards pass. Now 5/5 pass.
- `ClientsListPushPrimer.test.tsx` (3): on main 2 fail and 1 guard passes. Now 3/3 pass.
- `PushPermissionCard.test.tsx`: +1 coach-audience test.
- Updated: the `CommunitySpaceScreen.test` user now has a coach; `ClientsListRiskPill.test` stubs the card.

**CI @ 59ec5777: all green.** Typecheck, lint, test: [run 37496893581](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37496893581/job/112383621750). CodeQL: [run 37496893536](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37496893536).

**Size:** 11 files, +313/-29. No lockfile changes, no Expo/EAS changes.

**Cs (not in scope)**
- C-M393-1: the Roman `noCohorts` body still says "Your coach will place you in one", which a coachless client now sees without the button. A copy-only follow-up would fix it.
- C-M393-2 (edge, deferred to 10k clients): with the Hall flag off, Today's "Visit the Hall" falls back to coach Messages.

READY FOR AUDIT
